mostWorthwhile.text: Building the membrane bag was most worthwhile: the picture showed how the lipid heads face water while the tails meet inside the wall, creating an inside and outside.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the water channel was straightforward and a little less interesting on its own, though its arrows made the route clear.

surprise.text: I was surprised that a copy of a DNA instruction could leave the nucleus through a pore while the DNA stayed inside. The picture labels the copy RNA, but does not explain much more about it.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the goals and pictures gave each fitting a clear purpose. The final fitting was also the only combination offered.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to try another chapter: building the cell piece by piece made the structures and their jobs easier to picture, and I’m curious what gets added next.
